text: Limbes linéaires oblongs, à bords ± parallèles, brusquement et longuement acuminés au sommet, atténués à arrondis à la base, vert mat dessus, blanchâtres à la face inférieure, de taille variable, jusqu'à 50 X 15 cm.
Bouton floral ovoïde-globuleux, tomenteux jaune verdâtre.
Graines noires ou brunâtres tétraédriques ou tronc-pyramidales de 1-1,8 mm, à surface finement ruguleuse ou granuleuse.
Ovaries 0.6 mm long; style and style head 1.3 mm long.
Fruit separating into 4 nutlets, nutlets ovoid, 0.8-1 mm high, covered with very short, appressed hairs.
Shrubs to small trees, up to 5(-12) m, dbh up to 30 cm; flowering branches 2-3.5 mm thick, densely hairy (to almost glabrous), glabrescent.
Inflorescence robust and lax, 4.6-19.5 cm long, strigose or tomentose; pedicels 6-17 mm long.

taxon: Myristica fissiflora fissiflora W.J. de Wilde
text: Leaves (thinly) chartaceous, 25-35 by 7-16 cm, lower surface papillose.

Fronds not or very shortly stipitate, stipe to c. 0.7 cm; lamina to 150 by 1.5-3.3 cm, papyraceous, strap-shaped or widest at 1/3-1/2 its length, at base very gradually narrowed to a short truncate base, apex rounded to acute, margin flat or very slightly incurved; costa sparsely set with dark clathrate, dentate, elongate scales, similar but smaller scales sparsely scattered over the lower surface of the lamina.
Seeds: grain 11-30 by 3-4.8 mm of which rostrate apex 3.2-19 mm long, coma 2.7-7.5 cm long.

Annual herb 5–20 cm high, branched from the base, the proximal part of the stem decumbent and rooting; branches not winged, glabrous or nearly so. Leaves spatulate, 1.5–6 cm long, 0.5–2 cm wide, base long attenuate, margins denticulate, apex rounded to acute, glabrous, sparsely glandular beneath. Glomerules sessile, ovoid, 5–10 mm long, 4–6 mm in diameter, the glomerule bracts covering the wholeglomerule and making it look like a conifer cone; receptacle cylindrical to ellipsoid; bracts mauve to pink distally, ovate to lanceolate, 2–4.5 mm long, acuminate with a spinulose acumen, the tips spreading; capitula sessile; capitulum bracts 4, distally mauve, 1.5–2 mm long, distally erose, scarious and glabrous, the laterals folded. Florets 3–5; outer florets 2–4, cylindrical to slightly conical, tube 0.3–0.5 mm long, lobes minute, style 0.6–0.7 mm long, bifid; inner floret 1, tube broadly cylindrical, 0.5–0.7 mm long, lobes 0.3 mm long, anthers 0.3–0.4 mm long, style 1–1.3 mm long, briefly notched. Achenes cylindrical, 0.6–0.7 mm long, puberulous.
♀ à très jeunes boutons seuls connus; sépales 5, ovales, ciliés, pubérulents à glabres; pétales 5.
étroitement oblongues, arrondies aux extrémités, aplaties, ± ondulées, atteignant 7 cm de long et 2 cm de large, pubérulentes à glabres.
ou petit arbre de 1,5–15 m de haut; tige glabre, longitudinalement ridée; rameaux tomentelleux-fauves au sommet.

axillaires, 1-sexuées; les ♂ 5–9-flores, à pédoncule de 4–9 mm de long, grêle, pubérulent, muni au sommet de bractées ovales-lancéolées, atteignant 2 mm de long, ± caduques; les ♀ 3-flores, à pédoncule de 2–8 mm de long.
